name: Upgradation of Merit of SC Students
provider: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment (via States/UTs)

rules.quote: upgrade the merit of SC students by providing them remedial and special coaching in classes IX to XII
The coaching should start at class IX level and continue till a student completes class XII.
Income Ceiling: Rs. 3.00 Lakh per annum

amount.text: Package grant Rs 25,000 per student per year (Rs 15,000 to student incl. boarding, pocket money, books)
amount.quote: A package grant of Rs.25,000/- per student per year is provided

deadline.text: Implemented through States/UTs; 2,050 fresh students a year in 19 States/UTs
deadline.quote: Maximum 2050 fresh students will be covered under the Scheme annually.
